info.title: MeenMitra API
info.description:
MeenMitra MVP backend — **demo mode**.

* Forecasts are a *relative demo oxygen-risk index* from an uncalibrated physics-inspired model, not
  dissolved-oxygen measurements or predictions of when oxygen will crash.
* Water-quality thresholds are unvalidated demonstration settings; the rules engine never diagnoses disease.
* Alerts are delivered only through an offline mock provider; no real message or call is ever sent.
* Seeded ponds, readings, reports and alerts are synthetic.

Successful responses use `{"data": ..., "meta": {...}}`; errors use `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

template_review_status.title: Template Review Status
template_review_status.description: Kannada wording has not been reviewed by a competent speaker; not production-ready

ponds_by_status.title: Ponds By Status
ponds_by_status.description: Keys: safe, watch, danger, unknown (no forecast or water check yet)

data_nature.title: Data Nature
data_nature.description: Whether the records were measured, generated, or are unknown

external_request_made.title: External Request Made
external_request_made.description: The mock provider never calls an external service or phone network

data_origin.title: Data Origin
data_origin.description: external = downloaded third-party dataset (see its data_nature); synthetic = generated here

aerator_used.title: Aerator Used
aerator_used.description: Aerators ran overnight; the outcome then says little about natural demand

contribution_points.title: Contribution Points
contribution_points.description: Change in the window-average risk index versus the reference value, with all other inputs unchanged (one-at-a-time sensitivity)

inputs_hash.title: Inputs Hash
inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of the resolved inputs; equal inputs give equal outputs

forecast_date.title: Forecast Date
forecast_date.description: Evening on which the window starts (IST). Defaults to today in IST.

start_hour.title: Start Hour
start_hour.description: Local hour (IST) at which the window starts

end_hour.title: End Hour
end_hour.description: Local hour (IST) next morning at which the window ends

aerator_planned.title: Aerator Planned
aerator_planned.description: Whether aerators will run overnight. Defaults to the pond's has_aerator value.

use_live_weather.title: Use Live Weather
use_live_weather.description: Try Open-Meteo when WEATHER_PROVIDER=open_meteo; falls back to the scenario on failure.

create_alert.title: Create Alert
create_alert.description: Create a pending alert when the result is watch or danger

peak_risk_time.title: Peak Risk Time
peak_risk_time.description: Hour with the highest simulated relative risk — not a predicted oxygen-crash time

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.title: Dissolved Oxygen Mg L
dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.description: Evening dissolved oxygen measured with a meter or kit, mg/L

ForecastWaterInput.title: ForecastWaterInput
ForecastWaterInput.description: Optional evening observations entered by the farmer (treated as observed inputs).

demo_mode.title: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Always true in this MVP: data is synthetic or user-entered demo data.

demo_mode.title: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Always true in this MVP: data is synthetic or user-entered demo data.

contact_phone.title: Contact Phone
contact_phone.description: E.164 Indian number, e.g. +919800000000. Stored locally, masked in responses. The mock provider never contacts it.

area_m2.title: Area M2
area_m2.description: Water surface area in square metres

estimated_biomass_kg.title: Estimated Biomass Kg
estimated_biomass_kg.description: Farmer's estimate of standing fish/shrimp biomass

overall_status.title: Overall Status
overall_status.description: Worse of the latest forecast and latest water-check status

simulate_failure_channels.title: Simulate Failure Channels
simulate_failure_channels.description: Demo control: force these channels to record a simulated failure

total_ammonia_mg_l.title: Total Ammonia Mg L
total_ammonia_mg_l.description: Total ammonia nitrogen (TAN), mg/L as N, from a test kit

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the sample/observation was taken (defaults to now)

sunshine_hours_today.title: Sunshine Hours Today
sunshine_hours_today.description: Bright sunshine hours during the preceding day

wind_speed_ms.title: Wind Speed Ms
wind_speed_ms.description: Mean overnight wind speed at 10 m, m/s

rainfall_mm.title: Rainfall Mm
rainfall_mm.description: Rain expected during the forecast window, mm

WeatherInput.title: WeatherInput
WeatherInput.description: Evening-to-morning weather summary. Any omitted field is taken from the scenario preset.
